title: Lavender Kissed Polish Russet Potato Croquettes
description: A daring fusion of comforting Polish krokiety and Japanese agemono technique, featuring crispy russet potatoes infused with a delicate hint of culinary lavender.

ingredients.name: Pork rinds
ingredients.notes: crushed into fine crumbs for breading

instructions: Boil the cubed russet potatoes in salted water until they are fork-tender, which takes about fifteen minutes.
Drain the potatoes thoroughly and mash them in a large bowl until completely smooth.
Stir in the ground culinary lavender, melted ghee, garlic powder, and half a teaspoon of sea salt until fully incorporated.
Allow the potato mixture to cool completely in the refrigerator for twenty minutes so it becomes easy to shape.
Divide the chilled potato mixture into eight equal portions and shape each into a smooth cylinder.
Roll each cylinder first in the almond flour, then dip it into the beaten egg, and finally coat it thoroughly in the crushed pork rinds.
Heat the avocado oil in a deep pot to three hundred sixty degrees Fahrenheit.
Fry the croquettes in small batches for about three minutes until they are golden brown and crispy.
Drain the finished croquettes on paper towels and sprinkle them with a pinch of sea salt before serving.
